corrections.text: The headline calls Altinity a "ClickHouse support provider" and says "integrated offerings" are planned for Q4 2026. EDB's release describes Altinity as "a leading independent provider of enterprise software, managed services, and support for ClickHouse software", so support is one of its lines of business alongside its builds, Kubernetes Operator and Altinity.Cloud. The release says EDB "plans to introduce integrated enterprise ClickHouse capabilities in Q4 2026" and that "Capability and deployment availability will be detailed as offerings are introduced"; none of the cited sources names a specific product or offering for that quarter.
